claims.reasoning: That roster spot wasn't doing anybody any good - empty jersey, zero snaps, not earning its spot. Courtland Sutton shows up for Denver every Sunday, blocks when he's not the target, never been a lick of trouble in any locker room - that's the kind of professional I want sitting behind Keenan. Eight dollars is a fair depth price, not a reach.

note_reply: No note from the front office this week, and that's just fine - quiet weeks are earned too. We control what we can control: show up, do your job, play the next down. Clear eyes, full hearts, same as always.
